s: SMTP, SendGrid, push notifications, webhooks, templating
d: Every app sends emails and notifications — transactional emails, marketing campaigns, push notifications, SMS alerts. Understanding email delivery (SMTP, SPF, DKIM), notification queues, and templating systems is essential for production systems.
c: Email services (SendGrid, AWS SES, Postmark, Resend)

p: Email Notifications is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
